g.text: ACID vs BASE: two paths through one social app
Same app, same database technology -- the letters describe the operation, not the system
Basically available: the like is accepted and shown to the user instantly,
Soft state: replicas can disagree for a moment; the count itself can drift
even with no new likes, as the write keeps propagating.
Eventually consistent: once writes stop, every replica converges -- and
nobody scrolling past the post ever notices the gap.
Atomic: a reader can never see the account gone but its posts still
Isolated: no other transaction sees this account mid-deletion.
Durable: once COMMIT returns, the deletion survives a crash the very
next instant -- it does not un-happen.
